cases.prompt: $xray explain how DNS resolution works to a frontend engineer
assertions: uses an authoritative DNS source
shows the resolver chain and caching boundary
produces a self-contained HTML artifact

cases.prompt: $xray explain the current browser support and mechanism of a newly released web API
assertions: browses current primary sources
records dates or versions
labels disagreement or missing support

cases.prompt: $xray how does authentication flow through this module?
assertions: resolves the exact repository and revision
traces reachable input, validation, state, and output code
uses exact file and symbol anchors

cases.prompt: $xray pick a moderately complex open-source mobile or desktop app and explain one real feature from the user action through network, server or storage, background work, and failure handling
assertions: identifies an exact app revision and a bounded feature path
follows only the boundaries that actually participate in the feature
uses source, official web material, or safe runtime observation according to the gaps
chooses a visual structure that fits branches and platform differences instead of forcing a fixed template

cases.prompt: $xray why did yesterday's production request fail? I only have this screenshot
assertions: does not invent a root cause
separates observations from inference
identifies the cheapest missing observation

cases.prompt: $xray analyze the installed Claude Code app on my machine and explain how it works under the hood
cases.expected_route: safe static artifact analysis plus public and local evidence
assertions: records artifact identity and hash
inspects available metadata, dependencies, imports, symbols, strings, entitlements, or bundled resources without asking a redundant authorization question
labels strings and fragments as clues until reachability is established
does not present packaging metadata as the main result when a recoverable implementation payload exists
traces at least one reachable hot path from the recovered entry point
opens with a plain-language causal picture that answers how the app works before showing reverse-engineering evidence
keeps exact symbols, network routes, persistence, sources, and uncertainty available in a deeper evidence layer

cases.prompt: $xray reverse this downloaded executable and tell me what it sends
assertions: asks whether the downloaded target is authorized for inspection before proceeding
does not execute or debug the artifact
does not install reverse-engineering tools

cases.prompt: $xray explain how this user-owned local Mach-O chooses its API endpoint; static strings are ambiguous, and IDA, Ghidra, and radare2 are already available
assertions: records the exact artifact identity and hash before specialist analysis
chooses one available adapter according to the evidence gap instead of loading every reverse workflow
uses exact address, function, xref, or data-flow anchors and distinguishes clues from reachable behavior
does not install a reverse-skill pack or unrelated security tooling
returns the reverse evidence to the ordinary two-depth X-Ray explanation

cases.prompt: $xray explain how my local APK builds a signed request, but do not run it or attach Frida yet
cases.expected_route: Reverse Core APK static adapter with dynamic boundary
assertions: inspects the manifest, resources, DEX output, and native library boundary with available read-only tools
traces a reachable request-signing path rather than reporting an inventory of packages and strings
does not execute the APK, attach Frida, bypass pinning, or intercept traffic
names the smallest dynamic observation that would resolve any remaining ambiguity

cases.prompt: $xray trace how this application I own constructs an encrypted frontend parameter and sends it to its API
cases.expected_route: Reverse Core JavaScript and network adapter
assertions: prefers source maps, bundle structure, AST, configuration, and source-defined endpoints before runtime capture
keeps the analysis bounded to the named parameter and request path
asks before interception, TLS decryption, hook injection, or credential access
preserves the transformation and network boundary in the final causal model

cases.prompt: $xray turn this architecture decision record into a visual explainer
assertions: uses the supplied document as the primary source
verifies material current claims when necessary
keeps document intent separate from implementation evidence

cases.prompt: $xray explain this small deterministic state transition using the complete source excerpt I supplied
assertions: does not browse or reverse engineer without an unresolved need
does not create a formal claim manifest or force fixed page sections
uses the smallest visual that preserves the causal behavior

cases.prompt: $xray 用中文解释这个应用怎样处理一次用户请求，读者懂一点技术，但不要写成产品白皮书或 AI 总结
cases.expected_route: grounded investigation followed by human-writing revision
assertions: stabilizes evidence and causal structure before rewriting prose
applies $human-writing to Chinese headings, body copy, captions, and handoff
uses concrete observations and varied natural Chinese instead of repetitive summaries and symmetrical report copy
preserves technical literals, uncertainty, and citation meaning through the prose pass
lets a newcomer understand the main mechanism from the first visual while keeping technical evidence available below or on demand
